Diego: Heads-up: INV-6240 (BrightWave Analytics) bounced 890001111 card_declined: insufficient_funds. Customer called support asking for a short-term payment plan.
Maya: Do we have another card on file?
Diego: Only one card (last4 8877). They attempted retry once; payments-gw posted `payment_attempt.failed: insufficient_funds` at 1890001135.
payments-gw: charge.failed: insufficient_funds at 1890001135.
Tess: Has the customer asked for ACH?
Diego: They asked for ACH and a 30-day split (50% now, 50% in 30d). They said treasury prefers ACH but their bank's microdeposits are failing (bank returns `account_unverified`).
Maya: If microdeposits failing, we can't accept ACH. Can we do card-on-file retry + short-term invoice plan? Need approvals.
Ravi: Finance policy allows split payments for enterprise accounts with AE sign-off. Is BrightWave on an enterprise contract?
Diego: They're on Growth now but enterprise committed a month ago; AE indicated arrangement pending legal signature.
Tess: We should avoid forcing cancellation. Two options to present: 1) secure card update via link + immediate retry, 2) manual wire for full amount, 3) short-term split (requires AE + finance approval).
Maya: I'll validate their PO and approver before we offer split. Also capture proof of declined auth in Zendesk.
billing-bot: Zendesk ticket 8423 updated: decline screenshot attached at 1890001188.
Ravi: If customer wants split, we need a signed payment plan addendum and set invoice to Pending Manual Payment. Also tag ledger for partial settlement.
Diego: AE (Liam) says he'll confirm signature within 24h. In the meantime, can we enable a one-time manual retry?
Maya: Manual retries allowed once after contacting customer for updated method. If they refuse, escalate.
Tess: Draft outreach I can send: 
"Hi Kay,
We noticed INV-6240 failed due to insufficient funds. You can update your card here: <secure-link> or let us know if you prefer a wire. If you need a 30-day split, reply and we'll coordinate approval with your AE.
— Tess, Redwood Billing"
Diego: Send it. If they pick split, I'll queue AE + finance for approval.
payments-gw: Note: attempted retry blocked by issuer at 1890001250 (reason: contact bank).
Maya: Customer replied: prefers split and confirms AE (Liam) can sign. Wants first 50% paid by card today.
Ravi: Approving conditional split: set up two invoices (INV-6240-A 50% due today, INV-6240-B 50% due in 30d). Mark both non-auto-collect and require AE signature on addendum.
Diego: Creating invoices and tagging for reconciliation. Pausing auto-retries.
billing-bot: QuickBooks: INV-6240 status -> Pending Manual Payment at 1890001310. Created INV-6240-A and INV-6240-B at 1890001330.
Tess: Sent secure link to update card for the 50% payment. Customer charged successfully for 50% at 1890001422 (payments-gw posted `charge.succeeded`).
payments-gw: charge.succeeded (partial) at 1890001422.
Maya: Great. I'll record partial settlement and attach signed AE confirmation when available. We'll recon with ledger once second installment posts.
Ravi: Add note: if second installment fails, follow normal collection + AE escalation.
Diego: Closing thread. Will reopen if any hiccups on second payment. :white_check_mark:
